body: تجربتي مع بنك ابوظبي الاول دائما هناك تعقيدات غير مبررة رغم توجيهات القيادة الرشيدة بتحويل الخدمات الى الكترونية، الى انه لاحظت ان بنك ابوظبي الاول يعقد بعض الطلبات الكترونيا منها مثلا عدم توفير خيار تغيير تاريخ كشف الحساب لبطاقات الائتمان. لهذا للاسف قررت اغلاق بطاقة اماراتي وعلى الاغلب بطاقتي الاخرى الكاش باك لوجود منافسين بنسب اعلى وخدمات الكترونية اسهل وافضل وبشفافية. كما بعد مراجعة مكافات بطاقة اماراتي، وجدت تعارض واضح في قيمة المكافات التي حصلت عليها مع المعلن عندها عحسب شروط البنك. وهذا امر يفتقد للمصداقية ويزرع الشك وعدم الثقة. ارجو ان يتطور البنك للافضل وهذا الاننتقاد لعله يتم التحسين.

title: Mobile banking And debit card blocked
body:
My Experience with FAB Bank – Very Disappointing

I am very disappointed with my experience with FAB Bank. My Mobile Banking App and debit card have been blocked since 5 October 2026. Despite submitting all the requested documents and contacting Customer Care almost daily, my issue remains unresolved.

This prolonged delay and lack of a satisfactory response have caused me unnecessary stress and difficulties in managing my daily financial transactions.

I understand that banks must carry out security checks and verification procedures, but customers should receive timely updates and proper support throughout the process.

Unfortunately, this experience has significantly reduced my confidence in FAB Bank, and I would not recommend its services based on my experience. I sincerely hope FAB improves its customer service and resolves such issues more efficiently in the future.

title: Half baked wallet with poor design and no real support
body:
The interface feels somewhat childish, overly gamified and visually busy for a financial app. With the amount of bright promotional content, rewards, vouchers, referrals, and repeated action tiles, it sometimes comes across as more playful than professional.

More importantly, basic banking information is missing. I could not find a clear answer anywhere in the app, help section, or FAQs about whether the account can receive an inbound international SWIFT transfer from an employer abroad. For a product that provides an IBAN and SWIFT code, that is a basic question that should be answered clearly.

Support is effectively nonexistent. My account holder name was clipped incorrectly, so I contacted support to have it corrected using the Emirates ID they had already verified. I have sent more than five emails and in-app support messages about the same issue and have not received a single meaningful response.

Payit is clearly not intended to be a full banking product, which is fine, but then it should be clear about what it can and cannot do. Instead, the app puts far more effort into promotions, rewards, remittances, and gamified features than into providing clear account information and functioning customer support.

It may be adequate for very basic wallet use, but I would not rely on it as a primary financial account.

After contacting customer service, they reviewed my transactions and clearly confirmed that I am eligible for the cashback. However, the cashback was never credited to my account.
What is worse, when I tried to raise a complaint, the bank completely refused to open a case or provide me with a complaint number, which is unacceptable and prevents proper follow-up.
I have already attached my bank statements as proof and escalated the issue externally.
This kind of service and lack of transparency is very frustrating. I expected better from a bank like FAB.

title: Absolutely terrible banking experience with FAB.
body:
Absolutely terrible banking experience with FAB.

While I was traveling in the United Kingdom, FAB completely locked me out of both the mobile app and online banking. I urgently needed to transfer money, but I couldn’t access my account at all. The app simply would not work.

This is unacceptable for an international bank. Customers should be able to access their funds from anywhere in the world. Instead, I was left stranded without access to my own money during an important situation abroad.

The FAB app is constantly lagging, freezing, and malfunctioning. The functionality is limited, unreliable, and clearly not designed for customers who travel internationally. To make matters worse, customer support was either unavailable or completely useless when I needed help.

A bank should provide security and reliability. FAB provided neither. This has been one of the most frustrating banking experiences I have ever had, and I would not recommend this bank to anyone who travels or depends on online banking services.

Very disappointing.
★☆☆☆☆

title: The new update
body:
I’ve been trying to access my bank account for the past four days, and the experience has been extremely frustrating.

All I wanted to do was log in to my account, transfer money, and take care of some important matters. However, the new verification system in the banking app is completely impractical. The verification codes are not being sent to my phone number or my email, which makes it impossible for me to log in.

Because I kept trying to sign in and access my account, my account ended up being locked, which made the situation even worse.

To make things more difficult, I am currently outside the country, so I cannot visit a branch to resolve the issue. As a result, I’m unable to transfer money or do anything with my account.

I trusted this bank to be reliable and to support customers when they need access to their own money. Unfortunately, what’s happening now is causing serious inconvenience and stress. Instead of making things easier, the recent changes are making the service much harder to use.

Honestly, this whole situation is making me seriously consider changing banks as soon as possible if this issue isn’t resolved quickly.

I hope the bank reviews this issue and improves the system, because customers should not be locked out of their own accounts just for trying to log in.
author: n6_ow

title: Account closeing
body:
I had a very bad experience with FAB bank. I visited the branch 6 times to close my account and paid around 600–800 AED as they told me to clear the due balance. At first, the staff said that after paying the outstanding amount my account could be closed at the branch.

However, after I paid everything, they told me that the account can only be closed online. I tried many times (more than 100 times) to close it online but it still does not work.

This situation has wasted a lot of my time and money. Please help me close my account as soon as possible and confirm once it is done.

title: Mobile banking disruption
body:
It has been over a week since I was able to access the mobile app or Internet banking services, which I rely on daily for managing my account, paying bills, and transferring funds. Despite the company's advanced technological infrastructure, its technical team has been ineffective in resolving the issue during this period, leaving many customers inconvenienced and unable to perform essential financial transactions remotely. This situation is highly problematic, as it forces numerous customers to visit a branch or an ATM to complete their transactions, which is impractical and time-consuming, especially for those with busy schedules or mobility challenges. The lack of a functional digital banking platform is extremely disappointing, as it significantly hampers our ability to manage finances conveniently and securely from any location.
In comparison, another bank experienced a similar issue but resolved it within 48 hours, restoring full access to their digital services promptly and minimising customer disruption.

title: How this got a 4.8 rating I’d never know
body:
FAB mobile banking app takes you down memory lane. To the time when banks were experimenting with phone banking apps and no one had any clue what customer experience, or integrated/seamless technology was.

This app is comparable to my six year olds coding camp product. The authentication is so fool-proof that the only fool holding his/her breath is the customer. The authentication codes expire in two minutes but the security feature is so strong that it only sends you codes after 3 minutes. Potential misuse? Problem solved. 

You’ve also got to look at the interface with the type of nostalgia that should take you 15-20 years back. It does take a while to load - but in fairness they probably haven’t gotten to responsive designs in the coding camp for the kids that pulled this app together. 

If there was ever a competition of the best phone banking apps, this one certainly deserves a prize. But only for the misplaced bravado that they believe they can compete with other phone banking apps. 

I could also write about internet banking but it is so shoddy and unresponsive that I have no words for it. Literally.

body:
I am writing to formally escalate a complaint regarding a highly unprofessional and misleading experience with one of your sales representatives (B.F.), which has caused unnecessary inconvenience and financial concern.

I was contacted by your sales representative after requesting assistance in opening a bank account. During our discussion, I clearly explained my employment details and salary information. The representative was fully aware that my company is not listed under your approved companies for credit card eligibility. Despite this, he proceeded with opening a current account and submitted a credit card application without clearly informing me about the high probability of rejection.

After receiving my debit card, I did not receive any update regarding the credit card application. When I followed up with him via WhatsApp (as he personally requested), he informed me that there is a 90% chance that the credit card application would be rejected due to company eligibility. This information should have been transparently communicated before opening the account.

Based on this misleading process, I requested to close the account immediately since it was opened under incorrect expectations. However, I was informed that I would be charged AED 105 for account closure, which I strongly object to. This situation was not caused by my negligence but by the lack of proper disclosure and professional advice from your sales representative.

The representative mentioned he would raise a request to waive the charges but asked me to maintain AED 50 in the account, which I am currently doing in good faith while awaiting resolution.

I request the following actions:

• Immediate waiver of any account closure or related charges• Closure of the account without charges or Fees• Investigation into the conduct and communication transparency of the sales representative involved• Written confirmation once the matter is resolved

I have already registered this complaint under reference number: 2602******5286 and I expect this matter to be handled seriously and resolved promptly.

This experience has negatively impacted my trust in your institution, and I hope appropriate corrective actions will be taken.

Kindly treat this matter as urgent.

Sincerely,
A.M.
